target.effect_scale: Outcome ratio per doubling of annual PM10 exceedance days

coverage.rule: Nearest monitor within 50 km, at least 75% valid 2018 daily data, positive exposure and outcomes; retain 55 eligible capitals by SHA256 rank.
coverage.notes: All selected cities have 365 valid daily PM10 values (100% coverage); nearest-monitor distance 0.08-45.43 km.

blockers: Original 55 city identities, city-level outcome counts, original monitor assignments, and original exposure values were not available. The fitted analysis therefore uses explicit bounded source/geographic substitutions.

design_provenance.assignment_method: nearest EEA E1a validated PM10 monitor to municipal-capital centroid, restricted to 50 km
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: Number of 2018 calendar days with valid daily PM10 concentration strictly above 50 µg/m³

coverage_policy.evidence: A full calendar year has 365 days; 75% valid daily coverage is a transparent eligibility rule for a bounded public-monitor reanalysis. Coverage will be reported for all cities and a deterministic 55-city subset chosen only among eligible cities.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: The article does not report station assignments or a numeric completeness rule. The EEA E1a archive supplies complete public, validated, daily PM10 observations for 2018, enabling a city-centroid monitor assignment consistent with the article's city-level construct while making coverage and distance explicit.
evidence_basis: Official EEA API contract identifies Parquet time-series download endpoints and country/pollutant filters.
EEA E1a PM10 request for Italy produced a positive file summary.
EEA monitoring-station service yielded 763 Italian stations with coordinates and station identifiers.
